defs.def: the information, understanding and skills that you gain through education or experience 知识；学问；学识

ex.s: For example, I’m a car enthusiast, so when I teach physics, I contextualize concepts with my knowledge about cars.
ex.t: 例如，我是个汽车迷，所以教物理时，我会用自己的汽车知识来让概念更具体。

ex.s: Creative Workshops: learn basic repairs and artistic redesign of old furniture, while sharing knowledge and ideas with fellow volunteers,
ex.t: 社会与环境行动：通过创造力和合作帮助应对社会和环境挑战。

ex.s: Knowledge is power.
ex.t: 知识就是力量。

ex.s: “People could talk about gaining knowledge or personal growth,” says Johnson.
ex.t: Johnson说:“人们可以谈论获得知识或个人成长。”

ex.s: Renewed contact with a novel or a poem can activate the search for a better knowledge of the self.
ex.t: 意义是通过社会互动的过程产生的，而非计算过程，这种互动塑造了我们头脑中符号的内容。

ex.s: General knowledge can at times turn out to be true.
ex.t: 常识有时可能被证明是正确的。

ex.s: We can, instead, use this idea to advance scientific knowledge.
ex.t: 相反，我们可以利用这个想法来推进科学知识。

ex.s: One in four adults say that TV chefs have made them much more confident about expanding their cookery knowledge and skills, and young people are also getting more interested in cooking.
ex.t: 四分之一的成年人说，电视上的厨师让他们对拓展自己的烹饪知识和技能更有信心，年轻人也对烹饪越来越感兴趣。

ex.s: At worst, you will have refreshed and deepened your knowledge of the rules you normally apply, so that you can be even more effective next time.
ex.t: 最坏的情况是，你复习并加深了对通常所运用规则的理解，以便下次能更加高效。

ex.s: Long before reading and writing became widely spread and available, oral storytelling had already been a form that the wisdom and knowledge of the people were passed down from elders to children.
ex.t: 早在读写广泛普及之前，口头讲故事就已是人们将智慧和知识从长辈传给孩子的一种形式。

ex.s: It carries more wisdom and knowledge.
ex.t: 它承载着更多的智慧和知识。

ex.s: High levels of knowledge can make people too attached to traditional ways of viewing problems across fields the arts, sciences, and politics.
ex.t: 高知识水平可能让人们在艺术、科学和政治等各领域过于执着于传统的看问题方式。

ex.s: Understanding the world we live in, and using that knowledge to do useful things, is its own reward.
ex.t: 理解我们所生活的世界，并用这些知识做有用的事，本身就是一种回报。

ex.s: Develop broad, general knowledge and experience.
ex.t: 发展广博的一般知识和经验。

ex.s: narrow his range of knowledge
ex.t: 缩小知识范围

ex.s: brings knowledge of other fields to work
ex.t: 将其他领域的知识带到工作中

ex.s: You must have an excellent knowledge of office-related software．
ex.t: 你必须非常精通办公相关软件。

ex.s: Gaining high-tech knowledge.
ex.t: 获得高科技知识。

ex.s: Reading: A Source of Knowledge
ex.t: 阅读：知识的源泉

ex.s: New knowledge of human evolution.
ex.t: 人类起源的最新发现。

ex.s: They have transformed themselves into places where you can develop your love of knowledge meet interesting people, or find out how to start a business.
ex.t: 它们已经把自己转变成了这样的地方：你可以在这里培养对知识的热爱、结识有趣的人，或者了解如何创业。

ex.s: In the past, sound engineers worked in the back rooms of recording studios, but many of today's sound professionals are sharing their knowledge and experience with professionals in other fields to create new products based on the phenomenon we call sound.
ex.t: 过去，音响工程师在录音棚的后室工作，但如今许多声音专业人士正与其他领域的专业人士分享知识和经验，以基于我们所谓的声音现象创造新产品。

ex.s: Her knowledge of antiques.
ex.t: 她的古董知识。

ex.s: All participants must address how communication or transportation technology has promoted the quality of life for Americans throughout history． To many people，technology means computers， hand﹣held devices， or vehicles that travel to distant planets． However， technology is also the application of scientific knowledge to solve a problem， touching lives in countless ways．
ex.t: 所有参与者必须阐述通信或交通技术如何在整个历史中提升了美国人的生活品质。对许多人来说，技术意味着电脑、手持设备，或前往遥远行星的飞行器。然而，技术也是运用科学知识解决问题，以无数种方式触动着人们的生活。

ex.s: Most of my reading through primary， middle and high school was factual reading． I read for knowledge， and to make A's on my tests． Occasionally， I would read a novel that was assigned， but I didn't enjoy this type of reading． I liked facts， things that are concrete． I thought anything abstract left too much room for argument．
ex.t: 在小学、初中和高中阶段，我的大部分阅读都是事实性阅读。我为获取知识而读，为了在考试中拿A。偶尔，我也会读老师指定的小说，但我并不喜欢这种阅读。我喜欢事实，喜欢具体的东西。我认为任何抽象的事物都留下了太多争论的空间。

ex.s: Armed with  this  knowledge. they're able to carry out individually targeted campaigns to cheat people.
ex.t: 掌握了这一知识，他们就能开展有针对性的个人化活动来欺骗人们。

ex.s: Wang’s works show a deep understanding of modern architecture and a good knowledge of traditions.
ex.t: 王澍的作品显示出对现代建筑的深刻理解和对传统的良好把握。

ex.s: Her library used to be a  36  place for all who loved books and liked to share knowledge.
ex.t: 她的图书馆曾经是所有热爱书籍，喜欢分享知识的36个场所。

ex.s: Not only can you post specific questions, but you can broaden your knowledge by reading posts from other English learners around the world.
ex.t: 你不仅可以发布具体问题，还可以通过阅读来自世界各地其他英语学习者的帖子来扩展你的知识。

ex.s: This knowledge is passed down through families, which means that new generations continue to use ancient methods of agriculture to maintain the terraces.
ex.t: 这些知识通过家庭传承，这意味着新一代人继续使用古老的农业方法来维护梯田。

ex.s: Perhaps we comfort ourselves with the knowledge that most of the lies we tell are “white lies”: little lies that we tell to protect others from the truth.
ex.t: 也许我们用这样的认识来安慰自己：我们所说的大部分谎言都是善意的谎言——我们为了保护别人免受真相的伤害而说的小谎。

ex.s: This year, with an open mind and new knowledge in mind, I walked into another group interview while telling myself I was that cool senior.
ex.t: 今年，带着开放的心态和新知，我走进另一次小组面试，告诉自己我就是那个从容的高年级生。

ex.s: Job requirements Being a wildlife photographer requires good photography skills, knowledge of animal behaviour and a lot of patience.
ex.t: 工作要求作为一名野生动物摄影师，需要具备良好的摄影技巧、动物行为知识和充足的耐心。

defs.def: the state of knowing about a particular fact or situation 知晓；知悉；了解

ex.s: We also get enjoyment from the knowledge of how something was made.
ex.t: 我们也从了解事物的制作方式中获得享受。

defs.def: working with information rather than producing goods 信息，知识（与产品制造相对）

ex.s: Make connections between your background knowledge about this Chinese historical figure and the new information you read in the passage.
ex.t: 把你关于这位中国历史人物的背景知识与你在文章中读到的新信息联系起来。
